race.comment: Siding with the resuming PURPLE STREAK (4) who won dominantly on debut at Werribee before going on to run in some good races, including boasting a win over Celtics who went on to beat the highly touted Cruiserweight. Can improve this time in and should go well. ROMANTIC MISS (2) was down in the weights but stuck on well for a narrow defeat at Caulfield last time out. Back in grade for this hence the rise in weights and should go well again. SAVOYARD (3) has been okay in three runs back from a spell. Back to 1100m is interesting but he's got a big turn of foot and can be weaving through late. YUKAINA (5) just found one better fresh and can improve while PRESTIGE LUCKY (9) ran on well to score on debut in Adelaide and could measure up.
